question: What is the value of tan 240°?
solution:
**Given:**

tan 240°

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/039e4a37d8ff37771f8f3e93b2da751dc3cd0c83823eb42393de0c1bc3318160.png] 

**Calculation:**

tan240°

⇒ tan(180 + 60)°

⇒ tan60°

⇒ √3

**∴ The required answer is √3.**
